visualCharacteristics: Light ice panel with a kicker label and a single-line rail of underlined keyword links with prev/next arrow buttons.
contentPattern: Row 1: kicker paragraph (e.g. 'Discover also'); row 2: a bulleted list of links, one keyword per list item.
usage: Use at the end of a hub page to list related topic links in a scrollable 'Discover also' rail.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on any hub or solution page by replacing the kicker and the list of keyword links.
